title: Basic Hoe
description: Basic Hoe is a custom unbreakable iron hoe for Minecraft that auto-replants fully grown crops, harvests go directly to the player’s inventory, and glows for easy identification. Only authorized players can give it via command.
body:
# Basic Hoe
> Basic Hoe transforms the way players farm on your Minecraft server by automating crop harvesting and replanting, making farming faster, easier, and more efficient. When players use the Basic Hoe on fully grown crops, the harvested items go directly into their inventory while the crop is instantly replanted, saving time and preventing accidental loss. Immature crops cannot be broken with the hoe, ensuring maximum yield and protecting growing plants. The tool glows in the inventory and has a distinct green underlined name, making it easy to identify among other items. Only authorized players can give the Basic Hoe via command, but anyone can use it once obtained. Fully compatible with Paper and Spigot servers running Minecraft 1.20 through 1.21.8, Basic Hoe is simple, efficient, and enhances farming gameplay for survival and community servers.
